text:
Maya: morning wave check — we have a 09:30 PT deploy window for wave C (api-service v2.4.1, router v1.9.0). Quick roll-call for who is doing the deploy, smoke owners, and rollback readiness?

Rob: I can run the api smoke and do the deploy slot. 09:10 staging -> canary -> 09:30 prod.

Linh: I’ll take router smoke and stay on call for 30 mins after prod.

Sasha: I’m backup for router and can trigger rollback if needed. Also will watch tracing spikes.

Maya: thanks — can you both confirm rollback steps are gorun-tested and that runbooks are up to date?

Rob: rollback tested in dry-run yesterday. steps in runbook link: https://confluence.internal/infra/runbooks/api-rollback (tl;dr: rollback to v2.4.0, clear kv-cache, restart worker pool).

Rob: smoke command for api (copy/paste):
```
# run basic smoke
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_SMOKE_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.test/health | jq .status
# quick gen
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq .choices[0].text
```

Linh: router smoke checklist: 1) route table sanity, 2) edge TLS cert check, 3) 100 synthetic requests @ 200ms target. I’ll post results in this thread.

Maya: deploy-bot — can you confirm the scheduled job and attach the deploy ID?

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy 2957654321-rc deployed -> canary at 09:15 PT, prod at 09:30 PT, deploy-id: DPL-20260317-78.

Rob: staging smoke green at 09:02. Canary kicked at 09:15. No errors in logs so far. Perf looks steady.

Linh: router smoke: route checks pass, certs valid, synthetic 100 reqs p95=180ms, p99=350ms. tagging :thumbsup:.

Sasha: I’m watching traces and error budget. If 5xx > 0.5% in 10m I’ll trigger rollback.

Maya: rollback readiness ✅ — Rob, Linh, Sasha on rotation. If all green at 09:28 we promote to prod. If anything smells off, call rollback and ping #eng-oncall.

Rob: promoting in 2m. will post final smoke output.

Rob: prod smoke green at 09:31. sample gen qps within expected, no 5xx.

Linh: router prod smoke green at 09:33. leaving on-call until 10:03.

Sasha: thumbs up. will close watch at 10:00 if no regressions.

Maya: huge thanks everyone. filing small post-deploy note and tagging involved owners. :raised_hands:
